instruction.text: Read the start of the story and answer the questions.

atoms.text: The great stag approaches the reflecting pond and drinks the cool, refreshing water. As he drinks, he gazes into the mirror-like water and sees his reflection.
“My antlers make me look powerful and strong,” he thinks, turning his head from side to side, admiring himself from several angles. “I look regal, as if I could be a king!”
atoms.sound: ssml: <voice voice='m1'> “My antlers make me look powerful and strong,”</voice> he thinks, turning his head from side to side, admiring himself from several angles.<voice voice='m1'> “I look regal, as if I could be a king!”</voice>

atoms.text: His attention then turns to his legs. “If only my legs were also as strong! They look so skinny and weak.” He turns away from his reflection and leaves the pond.
atoms.sound: ssml: His attention then turns to his legs. <voice voice='m1'>“If only my legs were also as strong! They look so skinny and weak.” </voice> He turns away from his reflection and leaves the pond.

atoms.text: The following day, as the stag is strolling confidently through the forest, he hears a sound. The hair on his spine stiffens, his entire body tenses, and his senses become alert to the faintest drop of dew around him. He turns his head, waiting for another indication of where the sound came from or what it could have been.
